objective: Certify convex hulls of the original sampled-sphere geometry, including the original 32-by-16 workload, as required by properties.md and crates/hypermesh/FUTURE_WORK.md.
stage: Fresh failure reproduction and construction-certificate audit before a runtime change.
source: Snapshot current main and every existing in-scope native change. Inherit no rejected or unadmitted scalar runtime prototype.
reproduction: Build a fresh no-default-feature release library and a warning-denied external probe before querying any case.
Run each original exact sphere once in a fresh process under STRICT, retaining any typed error verbatim.
For successful hulls require Certified, every original coordinate unchanged, every sphere point retained, a closed manifold and 2V-4 triangles.
The fixed 180-second wall stop per process bounds diagnostic execution. It is not an acceptance threshold or either original DRC native limit.
Keep the original cases, all source hashes, binaries, logs and failures. No rationalization, display round trip, reduced substitute or sample replacement.
audit_requirements: A source certificate must follow from exact construction, not inferred mesh adjacency or an unproved floating-point plane.
Retained facts must be bound to immutable input coordinates, and must not survive coordinate mutation or replacement without valid reconstruction.
Review all intermediate hull predicates, not only final adjacent latitude-band quads. Preserve typed Unknown whenever no certificate applies.
Review affine transforms, clones, winding reversal, deduplication and hull output remapping before claiming reusable provenance.
Keep all 39 properties, 14 targets, crate future work, 35 pending native paths, full scalar obligations and original native cost failures in scope.
